Cut placement is ruled out by wave4/proposal_cuts.md 63|70: the pair is off +120 with the path at y 24550-24714, the north side candidate (off -120) is geometrically infeasible (crossed 5.85e9 - plate 70's footprint does not reach north of the legend across the run), and --furniture-visible was a tested negative result (the visible gap stays 0.196 M at W = 1, 2, 5, 20). Registration is also ruled out: block faces meet within ~3 ft and the round-5 constant ~5 ft translation is not what puts the legend in the street. The defect is that units.json unit 63 furniture_native[1] ("scale bar", native [1920,3622,2557,3718] = mosaic [18816,24445,20101,24645]) is cut:false at covered_fraction 0.830, and simply flipping it to cut:true is NOT sufficient - the simulated edit (crop_63_70_legend_furn.jpg) removes only the caption's east half and leaves the graduated bar and the 50 40 30 20 10 0 numerals, because furncover measures coverage against neighbour footprints while the 63|70 region boundary sits south of the box (y ~24610-24714) and Recipe.interior_unowned() then refills the hole from the covering plate, which is 63 itself. Durable fix, for Wave 1 not for a post-render patch: make furncover a second pass that measures coverage against ownership_city.json regions after streetcut rather than against footprints, keeping COVER=0.98, and extend unit 63's furniture box eastward/southward to the full grey scan-ruler extent (the present native box stops short of the eastern rectangle and the "of"/"50" fragments). Plate 70 draws that roadway completely, so the master keep-rule for boundary furniture does not apply here and no source gap is involved.

64_71.fix: Registration, not cut placement (no cut path can absorb a grid offset) - but this is the residual HQ-50 already documented and deliberately did not chase, so no recipe change is warranted now. HQ-50 added `recipe/controls/pair_64_71_x.json` (Ave N, a_native 178.3 / b_native 1177.6) and ran `localsolve.py --units 63 64 71 72 --similarity --apply`, taking the control from +13.0 to +3.9/+3.8 ft; my 4-5 ft measurement is exactly that surviving residual, and the wave4 proposal §5(a) attributes it to a real drawn-tilt difference between the rows (plate 63's N-S lines -0.0018 px/px against plate 70's +0.0044, 0.36 deg apart) that a similarity transform cannot absorb. Crop coordinates for anyone re-checking: representative step at x 370-390, y 600-1000 (the 3227/1502 vs 3301/1501 corner, 386.2 -> 374.0); worst at x 2360-2405, y 500-1000 (1600/1700 block corners, 5.2 ft after removing the 3 ft street-width disagreement). Any further gain would need a second-order/per-plate warp or more Ave-corridor ties between the 63/64 and 70/71/72 rows, which is outside the frozen recipe and outside the no-blend/no-redraw rules.
